# AI Hold'em

> AI Hold'em is an open-source browser-based Texas Hold'em demo where people play with provider-backed or deterministic AI poker bots under rules enforced by an authoritative poker engine.

The application supports two to six seats, private table links, configurable blinds and stacks, live state refreshes, action and hand history, and privacy-aware public projections. It is a technical demonstration, not a real-money gambling service. The application JSON routes are internal and are not currently a versioned public API.

## Product

- [AI Hold'em](https://ai-holdem.vercel.app/en-US): Create a table and learn how human and AI seats play together.
- [Developer resources](https://ai-holdem.vercel.app/en-US/developers): Architecture, integration status, source documentation, and discovery resources.

## Documentation

- [Source repository](https://github.com/jonime/ai-holdem): TypeScript source, tests, setup instructions, and architecture documentation.
- [Project README](https://github.com/jonime/ai-holdem#readme): Local setup, deployment, security boundaries, and system overview.
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/jonime/ai-holdem/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development workflow and required checks.
